title: Corporate-property ownership intelligence on HMLR property identifiers

problem_severity_frequency.rationale: Corporate-property ownership questions are recurring, but no evidence they are painful or under-served.

buyer_budget_clarity.rationale: Conveyancing/AML buyers identified but willingness to pay a new entrant is unproven and the data is open.

evidence_strength.rationale: Primary HMLR announcement plus a dated commercial index; buyer-side evidence absent.

distribution.rationale: Search-led acquisition plausible but untested; incumbents own professional toolchains.

differentiation.rationale: Capped at 2: direct incumbents (landregistry.company; enterprise providers) contest the wedge.

validation_speed_cost.rationale: A paid pilot is cheap, but establishing buyer need requires access to conveyancing teams.

feasibility.rationale: Joining open datasets is straightforward engineering.

economics.rationale: Capped at 2: commodity pricing (GBP1/title) and free OGL data; economics unsupported.

founder_fit.rationale: No differentiated capability; incumbent data vendors have the distribution.

risk.rationale: Low regulatory risk; commercial risk of competing with free/open data and incumbents.

economic_buyer.note: Conveyancing/AML teams identified but payment for a new entrant unproven.
economic_buyer.resolve_via: Interview five conveyancing/AML teams to establish whether they would pay rather than self-join open data.

painful_frequent_or_budgeted.note: Frequency and budget for corporate-ownership checks unmeasured.
painful_frequent_or_budgeted.resolve_via: Measure corporate-property ownership queries per conveyancing matter and the current tooling spend.

non_paid_distribution.note: Search-led acquisition untested in this niche.
non_paid_distribution.resolve_via: Test search demand for 'who owns this property' queries and inbound interest.

defensible_wedge.note: Open data plus an existing GBP1/title index and enterprise data vendors.

plausible_margins.note: Commodity data pricing; gross margin after data costs unproven.
plausible_margins.resolve_via: Price against the GBP1/title incumbent and measure gross margin.

cheap_disconfirming_test.note: A hand-built paid pilot report for one conveyancing firm.

not_all_optimistic.note: Requires buyers to switch from self-join/open data.
not_all_optimistic.resolve_via: Run the pilot; if firms will not pay above data cost, the case fails.
